[EXPERIMENTAL] Edit the status, priority or assignee of a policy issue

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] Edit the status, priority or assignee of a policy issue.

At least one of --status, --priority, --assignee or --unassign is required. Invalid
flag values or a missing change exit with code 2.

Allowed values:
  --status    open, in_progress, ignored
  --priority  p0, p1, p2, p3, p4
  --assignee  the Pulumi login of an organization member

Prints the updated issue in the same format as `pulumi policy issue get`.

```
pulumi policy issue edit <issue-id> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # Mark a policy issue as in progress
  pulumi policy issue edit <issue-id> --status in_progress

  # Set the priority and assign the issue
  pulumi policy issue edit <issue-id> --priority p1 --assignee <login>

  # Clear the assignee of a policy issue
  pulumi policy issue edit <issue-id> --unassign
```

## Options

```
      --assignee string   Assign to the Pulumi login of an organization member
  -h, --help              help for edit
      --org string        The organization that owns the issue
      --output string     Output format. Supported values are: default and json (default "default")
      --priority string   Set the priority (p0, p1, p2, p3, p4)
      --status string     Set the status (open, in_progress, ignored)
      --unassign          Clear the assignee
```
